Organization to Submit Nominees. -The Commission shall notify the duly
accredited professional organization of probable or existing vacancies in its
professional regulatory Board.
In the event that the organization fails or
refuses to submit nominees for a vacant position within the period prescribed
herein, the Commission may either recommend (a) the reappointment of the
incumbent or permit him to stay in a hold-over capacity if the law creating
the professional regulatory Board so authorizes or (b) the appointment of
